payload.text: 0.1.9's pre-cut gates on kovacs, on hv's decision 5 through vc's brief of 2026-11-13 11:01Z. Run as devbin's leg runs, by hand because release.legs names no host and vc said to leave the release config alone: main's tip sent by git send-pack (never git push) into ~/work/ccusage-leg.git on kovacs, with v0.1.8 beside it, then bin/devbin release gates in a worktree there under kovacs's own startup, driven through devbin's own leg functions (lib/release.legs), with its records kept in dc's scratch rather than this checkout. The Desk is asked first whether a kovacs run counts as heavy on rhadamanth. Then report to vc: the sha, each gate's verdict, the cargo and bats counts, and what Linux ARM64 does differently. Known before the run: actionlint is not on kovacs's PATH, so check all cannot pass there.
